rows.grounds: locative plural of numeral as given

items.question: By what count and in what contexts are beings said to endure torment according to this claim?
premises: Torment is said to occur in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
The location is specified as those womb-diagrams in the thousands.
The beings subject to this state are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The agent or cause of torment is not specified.
The duration of torment is not indicated.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
